Name: Utility Pocket
Author: ModderDrew
Description:
Adds a quick use slot for tools, weapons, and food.

Press "R" (configurable in config.json) to store/restore items in the pocket.
Press "Q" (configurable in config.json) to eat/use the items in the pocket.

You can specify key modifiers for the two keys above.

You can see the pocketed item in the lower left-hand portion of your screen.

This mod has not been tested in multiplayer.

If you experience loss of pocketed items, please do not complete the day or you will risk losing the item/tool. In this event, please submit a bug report and I will try to address the issue as quickly as possible.

[b]PLEASE REMOVE POCKETED ITEMS [b]AND FINISH THE DAY[/b] BEFORE UNINSTALLING THE MOD or you will lose the items in the pocket.[/b]


[b][u]Manual Installation
[/u][/b]- Drag and drop the "UtilityPocket" folder from the zip file into your mods folder


[b][u]To Update
[/u][/b]- Drag and drop the "UtilityPocket" folder from the zip file into your mods folder.
- When prompted, click "Replace the files in the destination" (Windows) 
- Ensure your data.json file in the assets folder is preserved

[b][u]Side Note[/u][/b]
Just released [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46799]Utility Belt[/url] which is an expansion of this mod with more features, configuration, and QOL upgrades. Let me know what you think! 
Decided to keep this mod separate from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46799]Utility Belt[/url] in case you guys want the single pocket/familiar mod.
